name: eldora-ui
title: Eldora UI
responsibility: Device and browser mockups — iPad/iPhone/MacBook/Safari frames for realistic product presentation. Hero and showcase sections present a website/app inside a real device frame instead of a flat screenshot.

upstream.notice: Full index (115 items incl. index) mirrored with contents. Refresh: curl -sL https://www.eldoraui.site/r/<name>.json -o eldora-ui/r/<name>.json

itemShape: shadcn registry-item: { name, dependencies[], files[{ path, content }] }. Key items: ipad, iphone-17-pro, macbook-pro, safari-browser.
reachFor: Hero sections and product showcases (HIGH importance per principle docs)
avoid: Redundant frames when the in-repo device stage family already fits (UI/content/device-*) — check it first
inRepo: complements the handcrafted device-stage presets; registry route preferred when a specific frame (iPhone 17 Pro, Safari) is needed
